description: Angular component for a filter dialog in the Thingsboard UI, allowing users to add or edit filters with validation and form handling.

classes.name: FilterDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating and editing filter objects within a dialog, with form validation and error handling.

methods.name: validateDuplicateFilterName
methods.description: Validator function to ensure filter names are unique within the list.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state for UI validation.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the filter data, assigning a new GUID if adding.
